patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — BookYourData and Gong share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

BookYourData and Gong share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose BookYourData only if your buying job matches “Real-time B2B contact database for building verified prospect lists with pay-as-you-go cre” rather than Gong's shape. Choose Gong only if your buying job matches “Conversation intelligence / revenue AI — per-user licenses + platform fee; custom proposal” rather than BookYourData's shape. Workflow advantage: BookYourData leans prospecting, email-outreach; Gong leans sales-engagement. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — BookYourData and Gong share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: BookYourData is Real-time B2B contact database for building verified prospect lists with pay-as-you-go credits and a 97% deliverability guarantee.; Gong is Conversation intelligence / revenue AI — per-user licenses + platform fee; custom proposal only (no public dollar list)..
- Workflow coverage skew: BookYourData-leaning prospecting, email-outreach vs Gong-leaning sales-engagement.
- Researched limits: BookYourData — none listed; Gong — Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases.

Limitations — BookYourData: —; Gong: Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases; Not a prospecting/enrichment data core.
